rows.label: Board of Pardons

sources.citation: Louisiana Department of Public Safety and Corrections, About the Board of Pardons & Committee on Parole
sources.quote: All members of the Board are appointed by the governor and confirmed by the Louisiana Senate. The Board of Pardons has five members.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: A.(1)(a)  The Board of Pardons shall consist of five members, who shall be appointed by the governor to serve terms concurrent with the governor making the appointments, or until their successors are appointed and take office.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: (b)  Beginning with appointments made to the board, or appointments to fill a vacancy on the board, which occur after August 15, 2010, at least one of the members shall be appointed from a list of names submitted by any victim's rights advocacy organization which is recognized as a nonprofit with the Internal Revenue Service, incorporated or organized in the state of Louisiana and in good standing, and does not engage in political activity, with each organization submitting a list of three names; however, no person nominated by any victim's rights advocacy organization shall be appointed to serve as a member of the board who has previously been confirmed by the Senate and has served as a member of the board.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: (c)   Beginning with appointments made to the board, or appointments to fill a vacancy on the board, which occur after August 1, 2014, all members, except for the ex officio member, shall have not less than a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, and shall possess not less than five years actual experience in the field of penology, corrections, law enforcement, sociology, law, education, social work, medicine, psychology, psychiatry, or a combination thereof.  If a member does not have a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, he shall have no less than seven years experience in a field listed in this Subparagraph.  The provisions of this Subparagraph shall not apply to any person serving as a member of the board on August 1, 2012.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: (d)  All appointments shall be subject to confirmation by the Senate.  The governor shall designate the chairman of the board.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: E.  Four members of the board shall constitute a quorum for the transaction of business, and all actions of the board shall require the favorable vote of at least four members of the board.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: F.  Each member of the board, except for the ex officio member, shall devote full time to the duties of his office, and shall be prohibited from holding any elective, appointive, or public employment; or from engaging in any private business or employment which is in conflict with his duties as a member of the board.

sources.handoff: Owner-authorized coordinator source recovery; independently retrieved correct RS15:572.1 on 2026-10-02; no raw hash asserted.
sources.quote: (2)  The ex officio member shall not be a voting member and shall not be counted or permitted to be counted for purposes of the number of members necessary to take board action or the number of members necessary to establish a quorum.

notes: Current statutory text governs the recovered profile; the older DOC summary alone did not include the seven-year alternative or degree condition.
Term is tied to the appointing governor and holdover; no fixed month duration invented.
At least one member must come from the legally qualified advocacy-list route. Until actual list records are bound, ordinary nominees cannot consume the final required capacity.
No retrieval date is treated as an operative date. Only the exact appointment cutoffs explicitly given in the statute are dated.
Unknown accredited degree is not treated as a degree: seven recorded years suffice under both alternatives; five-year degree and grandfather paths stay pending absent actual evidence.
No active participation or vote exists until the shared Senate confirmation route is wired.
